previous_admission_summary.summary_paragraph: A woman with a history of gastroparesis and chronic epigastric pain was admitted after developing abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, and diarrhea following a scheduled break from erythromycin. She experienced lightheadedness likely due to dehydration. Labs showed a mildly elevated lipase but no signs of infection or acute pancreatitis. She was restarted on erythromycin, received IV fluids, and her symptoms improved rapidly. She tolerated a regular diet, had no further pain, and was discharged home the same day in stable condition. Follow-up with her gastroenterologist was recommended to discuss long-term management of gastroparesis and antibiotic use.
